global: This miso ramen features a rich, amber broth cradling tender chashu pork and dark wood ear mushrooms. Garnished with shredded ginger and green onions, it sits in a pristine white bowl against a vibrant red background, illuminated by bright, even lighting.

regions.background: Red surface with smooth texture and slight sheen, forming a curved background behind the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: Miso ramen broth, rich amber hue, smooth surface with visible noodle strands and garnishes floating within.
regions.seaweed: Nori seaweed appears dark, crinkled, and slightly glossy with irregular, curled edges and a textured surface.
regions.meat: The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with a glossy, caramelized surface, showing distinct layers of fat and lean meat.
